# Regression test for #36: multiple window blocks + link navigation.
# All windows must be emitted; navigate() must exist; link with internal
# href must call navigate instead of opening the OS browser.

# Post-Plan-C the multi-window scaffold (buildWindowApp, buildWindowSettings,
# navigate, *Box fields, BuildUI Hide() calls) is restored and emitted
# correctly. What's still missing is link-tap interception: the link's body
# (a NodeInst inside the window body) goes through the broken renderStmt
# path, so the `OnTapped = func() { m.navigate("settings") }` override never
# emits and the final assertion fails.
#
# Tracked: once the renderStmt-over-lowered-IR rewrite (see
# compile_fyne_component_fields / compile_fyne_if_multibody) lands, the
# link-nav splice in view_ir.go will run again. Until then the
# m.navigate("settings") call site is missing.
skip 'fyne window-body link-nav splice missing post-Plan-C (scaffold OK, link tap not wired)'

sngl compile --platform=fyne --lang=go --opt=main=true --out=out app.sngl
exists out/model.go

# Per-window build methods
grep 'func \(m \*Model\) buildWindowApp' out/model.go
grep 'func \(m \*Model\) buildWindowSettings' out/model.go

# Navigation method
grep 'func \(m \*Model\) navigate' out/model.go

# Window container fields on Model (use \s+ for alignment spaces)
grep 'windowAppBox\s+\*fyne\.Container' out/model.go
grep 'windowSettingsBox\s+\*fyne\.Container' out/model.go

# BuildUI hides inactive window on startup; navigate shows/hides containers
grep 'windowAppBox\.Hide' out/model.go
grep 'windowSettingsBox\.Hide' out/model.go

# Internal link must call navigate, not open a URL in the OS browser.
grep 'm\.navigate\("settings"\)' out/model.go

-- app.sngl --
output { go { fyne } }

component main {
    window #app(title="App") {
        vbox {
            text(value="App page")
            link(href="settings", text="Go to Settings")
        }
    }
    window #settings(title="Settings") {
        vbox {
            text(value="Settings page")
        }
    }
}
